dz: 罗马皇帝特拉扬创立了"水口"(Aqua Traiana),是一条从罗马西北40公里(25英里)的布拉克恰诺湖通水的通水道.
de: Roman emperor Trajan inaugurates the Aqua Traiana, an aqueduct that channels water from Lake Bracciano, 40 kilometres (25 miles) northwest of Rome.
